label: Food and agriculture
description: A food processor or an agricultural enterprise: meat and poultry plants under USDA FSIS inspection, FDA-regulated food and beverage manufacturers, cold storage and food distribution, feed mills, and grain and farm-supply cooperatives with elevators, scales and agronomy dispatch, plus the farms, feedlots, dairies and poultry houses they serve. PLC-controlled lines, ammonia refrigeration, grain dryers and bin monitoring, ERP and grain accounting, lot traceability, and the food-defense plan, recall and animal-health obligations that go with them.

vocabulary.facility: the plant and its sites (processing lines, coolers and freezers, the ammonia engine room, elevators, bins and scale houses)
vocabulary.public: consumers, farmer members and customers, and the surrounding rural community
vocabulary.frontline: line operators, sanitation crews, maintenance technicians, scale-house operators, QA technicians, truck drivers, herd managers
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the plant manager's office / co-op headquarters, with the engine-room and line control rooms

factCategories.label: Processing / packaging lines
factCategories.noun: Packaging Lines?|Production Lines?|Processing Lines?|Bottling Lines?|Kill Lines?

it: ERP and accounting (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards)
grain accounting, agronomy dispatch and patronage (Agvance, AgTrax, Merchant Ag)
scale-house software, truck scales and grain grading analyzers
lot / batch traceability and label printing
LIMS and HACCP / food-safety records software
EDI and customer portals with retailers
email, identity and payroll for seasonal labor
ot: batching and mixing systems, feed-mill micro-ingredient dosing
pasteurizers (HTST) with recorder-controllers and clean-in-place (CIP) systems
metal detectors, X-ray inspection and checkweighers
ammonia refrigeration: compressors, evaporators, ammonia detectors and emergency shutdown
grain elevator controls: bucket elevators, conveyors, dryers, bin temperature cables, aeration fans
dust-collection and hazard monitors (bearing temperature, belt alignment)
livestock barn environment controllers with alarm dialers

roles.name: Plant Manager / Co-op General Manager (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Decides to shut down lines or stop receiving at elevators, ransom and insurer questions with counsel, and member and customer communications.

roles.name: Director of Food Safety and Quality Assurance
roles.description: Owns product holds, recall decision support, lab testing and HACCP / preventive-controls deviations.

roles.name: Food Defense Coordinator (qualified individual)
roles.description: Owns the food defense plan, the vulnerability assessment, mitigation strategies at actionable process steps, corrective actions and reanalysis.

roles.name: Plant Security Manager
roles.description: Owns access control, visitor and contractor screening, the perimeter, CCTV and insider-threat indicators.

roles.name: IT Director / Cybersecurity Lead (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns ERP, grain accounting, scale-house systems, backups, the MSP and the FBI/CISA liaison.

roles.name: Maintenance / Engineering Manager
roles.description: Owns ammonia refrigeration, PLC-controlled lines, boilers, wastewater and dryers.

roles.name: Communications / Member Relations Manager (PIO)
roles.description: Owns media, farm press and ag radio, member and farmer communications, and customer and retailer notices.

roles.name: Environmental Health & Safety Manager / PSM Coordinator
roles.description: Owns ammonia releases (PSM / RMP), grain-dust hazards, OSHA reporting and evacuation.

outsideParties: the USDA FSIS District Office and the Inspector-in-Charge on site
USDA APHIS and the state veterinarian
FDA (Human Foods Program, Reportable Food Registry) and CDC
the state department of agriculture and the state public-health food-safety program
EPA, OSHA and the National Response Center (ammonia releases)
the FBI (WMD coordinator, cyber) and CISA
local fire / hazmat, the sheriff and county emergency management
retail and food-service customers, ingredient suppliers and grain buyers
the ethanol plant, rail carriers and cold-storage operators
the cyber insurer, the DFIR firm and the MSP
mediaChannels: farm press and local ag radio
consumer posts on X/Twitter and Reddit about a recall
local TV and the rural newspaper
